get_dataset_map: get a CO3D dataset map for a given category and subset using JsonIndexDatasetMapProviderV2
load_pointcloud: load a point cloud from a file path and subsample to a maximum number of points
get_all_dataset_maps: load all train and val dataset maps from a CO3D path with optional holdout category filtering
get_rgbd_points: generate a 3D point cloud by unprojecting a depth map using a camera and optional mask
holdout_categories: reference the set of CO3D holdout categories used for train and validation data splitting
